name: OnPdfPrint
caption: When a PDF is printed

configuration.description: Report lines: [{ "reportId": <integer> }]. The flow runs only for these reports. At least one line (checked at publish); list each report once. A 'Source Table' column is shown in the config canvas but is NOT stored or used by this trigger.
How long the flow may run before Business Central uses the original PDF. Checked between steps; 0 or less means no time limit.

outputs.name: ObjectPayload
outputs.when: always; the full report payload JSON from Business Central as text

outputs.name: DocumentStream
outputs.when: always; the original PDF as base64. Removed from the execution data after the run.

outputs.name: ReportId
outputs.when: always; payload 'objectid' as text ('' if missing)

outputs.name: DocumentType
outputs.when: always; payload 'documenttype' (always 'application/pdf' because only PDFs fire)

outputs.name: Intent
outputs.when: always; payload 'intent' (e.g. Print, Preview, Save, Download, Schedule; '' if missing)

rules.check: configuration.reports must contain at least one entry (an object; non-object entries are skipped). Raised while registering the trigger (after licensing), aborting the publish.
rules.message: The "When a PDF is printed" trigger requires at least one report line.

rules.check: Only one published flow per environment may use this trigger. Registrations of deleted or unpublished flows are cleaned up automatically.
rules.message: Only one published flow can use the "When a PDF is printed" trigger. It is already used by flow '%1'.

rules.check: configuration.timeoutSec should be at least 1. Not checked: 0 or less means the flow runs without a time limit while the user waits.
Every reports[].reportId should be an existing report. Not checked: a line for a report that does not exist never matches.
If the flow fails, the execution is marked Error and Business Central prints the original PDF (the print itself does not fail).
rules.message: PDF Print flow failed before any body step could complete: %1

rules.check: A step that defers the run (Sleep) fails the flow, because the flow runs synchronously inside the report request. The user gets the original PDF.
rules.message: Step %1 (%2) requested a deferred resume, but the flow is running synchronously. Use Sleep or other time-based deferral steps only outside of synchronous frames (Webhook sync phase or SubFlow body).

notes: Fires from Business Central's 'document ready' report event for every intent (Print, Preview, Save, Download, Schedule), only for payloads with documenttype 'application/pdf' and only for reports listed in configuration.reports. If another extension already supplied a document, the flow is not started.

Synchronous: the flow runs inside the user's report request. The trigger output is committed first, then the flow runs until it yields (Return PDF), ends, fails or exceeds timeoutSec (checked between steps). All step state is committed once at the end; a failure rolls back the flow's database changes. Nothing continues in the background after a timeout.
End the flow with a Return PDF step to replace the document; otherwise the original PDF is used.
The DocumentStream output (base64 of the whole PDF) is deleted from the execution data after the run to keep the database small; it is not available when inspecting the execution afterwards.
Single catch-all flow: one published flow per environment handles all configured reports. Branch on {{trigger_ReportId}} for per-report logic.
The legacy single 'reportId' configuration key is no longer read; it is removed when the trigger is reconfigured.
The 'Source Table' column in the config canvas is not persisted for this trigger (only reportId is written). Use ObjectPayload to identify the printed records.
No recurring Job Queue entry is created on publish.
Picker filter: Return PDF is ONLY offered in this trigger's flows. Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Set report file name, Set document field values and Prevent page close are hidden.
